status: eighth aggregation slice: the fold stops merging once the accumulator re-converges with the retained prefix and the contributor tail matches; NovyWave merge falls 41% at the phase level while the end-to-end change stays inside the noise band

change.what: while merging the changed suffix, the fold now compares the accumulator with the retained prefix aggregate at the same position. When they match and the remaining contributor slices are identical, the rest of the fold is exactly the retained fold: the retained tail of prefix aggregates and its final aggregate are reused and the merge stops.
change.why: after the retained-prefix slice a fold whose first divergence was a genuinely changed contributor still merged the whole remaining suffix, even though the aggregate usually re-converges immediately (98.6% of NovyWave folds end with an unchanged binding).
change.soundness: the check requires both the accumulator to match the retained aggregate at that position and the remaining contributor terms to be identical, so the tail fold is the same computation over the same inputs; withdrawal or reordering changes the tail and disables the reuse.
